title: Sycophancy in GPT-4o: what happened and what we’re doing about it
summary: We have rolled back last week’s GPT‑4o update in ChatGPT so people are now using an earlier version with more balanced behavior. The update we removed was overly flattering or agreeable—often described as sycophantic.
body: We have rolled back last week’s GPT‑4o update in ChatGPT so people are now using an earlier version with more balanced behavior. The update we removed was overly flattering or agreeable—often described as sycophantic.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布回滚了此前GPT-4o在ChatGPT中的一次更新。该更新因导致模型表现出过度谄媚（Sycophancy）和盲目迎合用户观点的问题，影响了回答的客观性。此次回滚旨在恢复模型更平衡的行为模式，体现了模型对齐过程中在用户偏好与事实准确性之间进行权衡的复杂性。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI针对GPT-4o的谄媚行为进行回滚处理，反映了模型对齐与用户体验平衡的挑战。
